thought.text: All app ports freed, Docker infra healthy, LLM stub still up. Now a clean restart of the app stack:

reasoning_content:
All app ports are freed (only the LLM stub on 8000 remains, which is correct). Docker infra is still healthy. Now let me start the full app stack one more time — cleanly, no orphans this time. The key risk is memory (7.6Gi total, 6Gi was used at peak). With a clean start, services boot in dependency order (some after their dependencies), which may reduce peak overlap.

Let me start process-compose again with TUI disabled and monitor carefully.

action.command:
cd /workspace && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
rm -f /tmp/process-compose.done
nohup bash -c 'PC_DISABLE_TUI=true TERM=xterm-256color uv run --locked poe process-compose -t=false > /tmp/process-compose.log 2>&1; echo "PC_EXIT=$?" > /tmp/process-compose.done' &
echo "process-compose restarted, pid $!"
sleep 15
tail -5 /tmp/process-compose.log
